Absorbed.description: A closed campus taken into a larger educational system.

Cloud.description: Physical campus infrastructure converted into data infrastructure.

Corporate.description: Campus land or infrastructure absorbed into corporate use.

Educational reuse.description: The site remains educational under a new owner, mission, or scale.

Health.description: Institutional land reused by medical, hospital, or care systems.

Housing.description: Campus property converted to residential or senior living use.

K12.description: Higher education property converted to primary or secondary schooling.

Parcelized.description: A campus divided across buyers, agencies, or redevelopment parcels.

Religious/K12.description: A mixed religious and school reuse of former college land.

Ruin.description: The site remains abandoned, decayed, or unresolved.

Security.description: Educational land converted to state, training, or security use.

Speculative.description: Land held, marketed, auctioned, or repositioned as real estate.
